_note: Report templates. A template named "Default" is written straight into the empty box and is not offered as a button — it is simply what the form starts as. Any other template appears as a button the officer can press to swap the box's contents. A kind whose only entry is Default therefore shows no buttons at all, which is how the health report is set up. Use \n for line breaks.
